subject: Concourse Hall B/C main Ethernet trunk failure — panelist remote-bridge plan
messages:
From: Venue Oncall <oncall@concoursevenue.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Reed <tom.reed@saasconf.com>
Date: Sat, 7 Nov 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: URGENT: Main Ethernet trunk down in Halls B/C

Kimberly / Marissa —

Heads up: we’ve had a fiber handoff failure to the main switch for Halls B/C. Network team is on-site but we expect at least 2–3 hours for a full trunk splice. Impact: vendor uplinks and most booth Ethernet across the concourse are currently offline (including demo strips and the primary demo VLAN for Redwood in Booth B12).

Immediate mitigation we can offer:
- Reroute affected booths to an auxiliary PoE switch in Hall A via temporary Cat6 runs (30–45 min per run).
- Provisioned cellular bonded links on a rolling basis (can deploy 2 units now).
- SIP bridge for remote presenters if you need to move a panel remote — credentials attached.

I copied Tom from conference ops. We’ll keep you updated on ETA.

— Alex, Venue Oncall
Concourse Venue Technical Services

Attachments: venue-ethernet-topology.pdf

Subject: Re: URGENT: Main Ethernet trunk down in Halls B/C

Thanks Alex — copying ops and onsite techs. Quick summary for Redwood ops team:
- Impacted: demo cluster (B12), sponsor kiosk A4 (demo fallback), and the demo livestream for the 10:00 panel featuring Amy Park (speaker-amy@example.com).
- Priority: keep the panel on (10:00) with acceptable AV/latency for Q&A; keep demos live where possible but deprioritize non-customer demos.

Action items (assign):
- Marissa: coordinate cellular bonded unit deployment to Booth B12 and secure a spare hotspot for the sponsor kiosk. Confirm SIMs and test link by 09:10.
- Dylan: stand up Zoom + SIP bridge for Amy (she’s remote — she just texted she can dial from phone). Use the SIP creds from venue and attach to our A/V engineer channel. Confirm dial-in by 09:30.
- Laura: prepare a short on-stage script explaining limited connectivity and where attendees can view the recording later. Keep it <30s.
- Connor: coordinate road-run for a temporary Cat6 from adjacent Hall A switch if cellular fails. Estimate 45–60 min.

If trunk repair comes faster we’ll stop mitigations. I’m on-site and will triage.

Thanks — Kim

I’m on the AV line with the venue techs and Amy’s team now. Plan we just executed:
- Amy will dial the SIP bridge as a phone-only participant for audio (number provided in SIP creds). She’ll keep video off to conserve upstream.
- We launched a Zoom meeting on the laptop at the podium for panelists; Zoom host unmutes only the panel laptop for audio. Speakers will use the panel laptop for shared slides; Amy will drive slides by sending the file to the host via chat.
- Stream fallback: if bonded link drops, switch to phone-only podcast stream (low-latency) and capture slides locally for later stitching.

Testing at 09:05: audio stable, ping to Redwood demo endpoint 220ms, tokenized demo calls pass at reduced concurrency. Not ideal but workable for the 10:00.

Subject: Re: URGENT: Main Ethernet trunk down in Halls B/C — POST-MORTEM/notes

Thanks team — quick wrap:
- Outcome: 10:00 panel ran on hybrid: Amy dialed via SIP (phone audio), slides shown from podium laptop over bonded cellular. Attendee Q&A was moderate (we routed live questions through host and read them).
- Demos: B12 remained on cellular bonded link for duration of the morning; throughput stabilized to ~15 Mbps down after reconfig of the AP. Sponsor kiosk moved to brochure QR.
- Venue repair: fiber techs completed the splice at 11:40; full trunk restored at 11:55 and we migrated back to wired in stages by 12:00.

Follow-ups / lessons learned:
1) Add a dedicated spare PoE/patch kit to every Redwood show kit (Marissa + Laura to own).
2) Pre-stage SIP bridge credentials in conference ops doc (done; link above) and validate one test call 1–2 hours pre-show.
3) Expand bonded SIM coverage for high-density halls (ops to budget).

Connor — please open a JIRA (VENUE-4126) with the notes and attach the venue topology and SIP creds we used.

Thanks everyone for the quick pivot.

Kim
